edge_cases: single 32x32 crouton tile matmul on the HMX matrix engine
GELU (tanh approximation) epilogue is UNAVOIDABLY scalar (no HVX vector transcendental) -- fused after the crouton unpack, matmul itself runs on the matrix engine
HVX/HMX qf16 arithmetic is non-IEEE -> tolerance compare, not bit-exact
PLAIN SCALAR (no HVX, no HMX) matmul+GELU is the denominator baseline
crouton pack/unpack staged via cacheable buffers + bulk vector copy
missing-GELU near-miss (raw matmul passthrough) must fail
